name: Weavr
subtitle: Weavr for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV
description: Unsigned Weavr builds for iOS and tvOS. Add this source to Feather (or any AltStore-compatible signer) to install and update Weavr.

apps.name: Weavr iOS
apps.subtitle: 17 Nov 08:29 GMT · Multi-source IPTV with automatic failover
apps.localizedDescription: Weavr merges your M3U and Xtream sources into one library, removes duplicate channels and films across providers, and fails over to another source when a stream stalls. Includes a TV guide, films and series, continue watching, Picture in Picture, AirPlay, and WeavrLink, a remote for your Weavr TVs.

versions.localizedDescription: Qualities fill in faster: each source's copies read side by side with the others', 7 s a header at most
Fix build: no lazy chain over non-escaping closures in Home's newest row

Sources: refresh one part (channels, films, series, books) or everything

In a source's page, each switched-on part under Load has a ↻ that fetches
just that part again, leaving the rest as it is (films and series can now
be fetched apart). "Refresh everything from …" fetches the whole source,
books included, as does the Sources list's swipe-left Refresh.
Books tab only while a source has ebooks or audiobooks; LibriVox back in Radio otherwise

Media filter beside the bubble; server ebooks and audiobooks in imports

- Media's filter is a bare button left of the standard bubble (search,
  WeavrLink, profile), which keeps just those three on every page. Guide
  and Sport keep their own bubble on TV.
- Jellyfin, Emby and Silo audiobooks (a file, or a folder of files as its
  chapters) join their ebooks. Adding such a server on iPhone or iPad
  looks for both as steps of the import, and counts them in its totals
  ("… · 12 ebooks · 40 audiobooks"), there and in Sources. Each source
  has Ebooks and Audiobooks switches; off, Weavr doesn't look and drops
  what it had. The Books tab switches between Ebooks and Audiobooks;
  audiobooks play in the audiobook player, your place kept.

Genre folders drawn as on the TV

A still (a poster, on a poster-shaped shelf) from the genre's newest
title, in the genre's colour washing up from the name's corner; the icon
in a ring above the name (beside it on a wide folder); with no picture,
the icon large and faint behind for texture. iOS and Apple TV.

Detail page: cast, Available on, poster spacing; service folder filters

- Cast & crew: a cancelled first load (the film's TMDB id arriving after
  the page opened) counted as done, so the row never filled in. It now
  asks again, and searches by the clean title.
- Available on (as the TV): every service TMDB lists for the title here,
  with its logo; one tapped opens everything that service carries, Movies
  or Series, sorted Popular / Release date / Top rated / Alphabetical.
- Films lose the sources pill (series never had one); Choose source stays
  on the Play button's long press.
- The poster sits one margin below the back button.
- Service folders (Netflix…): All / Movies / Series, sort with direction,
  and a search.
- Genre tiles keep their artwork inside the tile, so the name shows.
Fix the VLCKit fetch on macOS bash; fail the step if it's missing

Guide: room by the channels, and a preview on tapping a channel. Audiobooks in your language. Duo keeps your place when folding/unfolding. PiP: live channels try their HLS feed first. TV page search filters live. Home: Top of Home setting and a Sport row. Radio music videos open full screen. Cast & crew with photos. Qualities checked on opening a page. Tidier category names.

Fixes: Silo no longer reloads its whole library on launch, and refreshing or adding one source only reads that source. Sport: nothing followed until ticked; a ticked team shows just its games. Start-up can't get stuck on a broken saved library. New Settings › Log. Emby/Jellyfin/Plex libraries can't loop. Restore uses the system file picker. Coloured swipe buttons on Sources.

apps.name: Weavr tvOS
apps.subtitle: 17 Nov 08:29 GMT · Weavr on Apple TV
apps.localizedDescription: Weavr for Apple TV: your merged IPTV library, TV guide, films and series with automatic failover between sources.

versions.localizedDescription: Qualities fill in faster: each source's copies read side by side with the others', 7 s a header at most

Books: read EPUB, PDF and CBZ in the app

- EPUB: unpacked once (ZIPFoundation), read from its package's spine a
  chapter at a time in a web view coloured to the app's theme, with the
  contents list, previous/next, text size, and your place kept (chapter
  and how far down). Links between chapters move the place; links out
  open in Safari.
- PDF: PDFKit, your page kept.
- CBZ: its pictures a page at a time, swipe and pinch to zoom.
- Other kinds (MOBI, AZW…) still offer Open in….
Fix the VLCKit fetch on macOS bash; fail the step if it's missing
First Apple TV build in a while: Sport and Grid tabs, live preview on Live TV, WeavrNet, cast & crew, Sport shelf on Home, OLED theme, Settings › Log, and the shared fixes from iOS.
